title: DecisionLogEntry
description: One row appended to state/decisions.jsonl per pipeline stage.

output_ref.description: Relative path under state/runs/{run_id}/ to the artifact this entry describes.

risk_warning.description: Mandatory warning string injected by lib/llm.py per spec.

cycle_intent.description: Which pipeline branch ran. trade = full pipeline (default for legacy rows); review = after-hours reflection (signals + strategist + meta only, no orders).

intent_source.description: Where the cycle_intent was loaded from. file = persisted via prior cycle's next_run.json; cli/env = manual operator override; default = no signal anywhere.
